about: Seed list of the three priority Agent Orange / dioxin hotspots at former US military airbases in Vietnam. Coordinates are approximate reference points (airbase or airport), good to roughly 1-2 km. This says where publicly reported hotspots are, not where contamination starts or ends. Add primary-source citations before anyone relies on it.

hotspots.name: Bien Hoa airbase
hotspots.summary: Former US military airbase where Agent Orange herbicides were stored and handled. One of the three priority dioxin hotspots in Vietnam.

hotspots.name: Da Nang airport
hotspots.summary: Former US military airbase (now Da Nang International Airport) where Agent Orange herbicides were stored and handled. One of the three priority dioxin hotspots in Vietnam; a joint US-Vietnam remediation programme has been carried out here.

hotspots.name: Phu Cat airbase
hotspots.summary: Former US military airbase (now Phu Cat Airport) where Agent Orange herbicides were stored and handled. One of the three priority dioxin hotspots in Vietnam.
